requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments online at their convenience.
Customers should have the ability to cancel or reschedule their appointments independently through the system.
The system should display available time slots for specific barbers, allowing customers to choose both their preferred barber and appointment time.
Automatic reminders should be sent to customers a day before and an hour before their appointments via SMS and email.
The system should integrate seamlessly with the current workflow and remain easy to use for everyone involved.
